classification: Source-confirmed false-success risk; no observed live PAPER dispatch incident
signal: main cloud-paper-runner.yml workflow_dispatch register job runs only echo Registered and would exit 0 without PAPER work
root_cause: Registration-only placeholder was represented as a successful Cloud PAPER Runner job
impact: A green manual dispatch on main could be mistaken for live read-only feed, forecasts or runtime health
prevention_hypothesis: Preserve workflow registration but emit CLOUD_PAPER_NOT_DEPLOYED and nonzero exit; run structural regression at exact PR head without skips

patch.changes: explicit error and exit 1, contents read, manual only, PAPER_MODE=1, LIVE_ORDER_AUTHORITY=0, REAL_BROKER_ORDERS=0

rollback: Revert this isolated PR only after the reviewed PAPER runner has been merged and genuine dispatch evidence is verified; never replace the block with success-only echo.
recurrence: Reopen if main registration-only dispatch exits zero without genuine PAPER evidence, or if guard test/sha attestation is skipped, missing, or fails.
